preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: N is the number of vertices in the tree and satisfies 1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= Q <= 10**5 for Q in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and ' ' in line and line.split()[0].isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Q is the number of queries and satisfies 1 ≤ Q ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and line.split()[0].isdigit() and line.split()[1].isdigit() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:N])
preconditions.description: The first N-1 lines represent undirected edges of the tree, each with two distinct integers between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line in stdin.splitlines()[N:N+1])
preconditions.description: The N-th line contains exactly N integers representing the array A, where each A[v] satisfies 1 ≤ A[v] ≤ 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 1 or (len(line.split()) == 2 and line.split()[0].isdigit() and (line.split()[0] == '1' or line.split()[0] == '2')) for line in stdin.splitlines()[N+1:N+1+Q])
preconditions.description: Each of the Q queries is either of type 1 (update A[v] = x) or type 2 (compute sum for subtree of v), where 1 ≤ v ≤ N and 1 ≤ x ≤ 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= N for line in stdin.splitlines()[N+1:N+1+Q] if line.strip() and line.split()[0] == '2' and line.split()[0].isdigit() and len(line.split()) == 1)
preconditions.description: For type 2 queries, v is a vertex in the tree (1 ≤ v ≤ N).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= N and 1 <= x <= 10**9 for line in stdin.splitlines()[N+1:N+1+Q] if line.strip() and line.split()[0] == '1' and len(line.split()) == 2)
preconditions.description: For type 1 queries, v is a vertex in the tree (1 ≤ v ≤ N) and x is an integer satisfying 1 ≤ x ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() == str(sum_vis_mod) for stdout_line, query in zip(stdout.splitlines(), queries) if query.startswith('2') and (sum_vis_mod := compute_sum_vis_mod(query, A, G, N)) is not None)
postconditions.description: For each type 2 query 'v', the output line is the sum of vis[u] for all u in the subtree of v (including v) after running the modified DFS algorithm with vis initialized to 0, computed modulo 10^9+7. The modified DFS algorithm increments vis[v] by 1 for each of the A[v] iterations, and recursively processes all children of v (excluding parent p) in each iteration.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_line.strip()) <= 10 for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines() if stdout_line.strip().isdigit())
postconditions.description: Each output line for a type 2 query is a non-negative integer represented as a string with at most 10 digits (to accommodate modulo 10^9+7).
